description: Structured semiformal proof system. Author .wit proofs, inspect .lean files, run Lake builds in the current worktree, check structure, build LLM-ready verification contexts, and persist receipts.

bin.description: List .wit and .lean files in the worktree
Run `wit verify` on a file (optional --step N.M)
Read verifier output from stdin and save .receipt.json
Run `lake build` from the nearest Lake project for a .lean file

iframe_commands.name: open
iframe_commands.description: Load a .wit file or open a .lean file in the Lean panel

iframe_commands.name: check
iframe_commands.description: Run wit check on the current file

iframe_commands.name: verify
iframe_commands.description: Run wit verify; with no arg verifies all steps, or pass a label like 3.1

iframe_commands.name: context
iframe_commands.description: Show the isolated verification context for one step

iframe_commands.name: focus
iframe_commands.description: Highlight a step in the proof tree

iframe_commands.name: lake-build
iframe_commands.description: Run `lake build` for the selected Lean file
